policy.timestamp_source: collector elapsed_seconds; no clock retiming or annotation shifts
policy.threshold_basis: Frozen using firmware/collector source and label-blind session_01/session_02 acquisition characterization only. Observed development trial rates 26.37-85.94 Hz. Floor 20 Hz is below the slowest observed development mean but rejects sparse streams. Require real samples in >=24/30 100ms bins, >=90% sample span and <=100ms unsupported endpoint distance. Preserve 250ms maximum interpolation gap; never extrapolate. Neither test labels nor test performance selected thresholds.
